quest.title: Wangshu
quest.description: You came across an adeptus, "Moon Carver." Seeing the keepsake you bore, he lent you his aid and protected you from the Millelith soldiers pursuing you. Upon learning of Rex Lapis' passing and the unjust accusations laid against you, Moon Carver expressed disdain for the Qixing's actions and began to suspect that they were behind what happened. He has sent you to find several other adepti and deliver a message to them.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x475, Primogem x30, Mora x14600, Adventurer's Experience x6, Mystic Enhancement Ore x3

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, this seems to be Wangshu Inn.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Oh. It's you two.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We meet again! Hiya!

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Why do you insist on getting involved in the world of demons and adepti? You're breaking the rules too often.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Mortal souls are not as robust as those of adepti, nor can your blood carry this level of adeptal energy.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: It's for your own good. Leave. Now.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait a sec, we came here to...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Argh! Paimon's... peeved! All he does is think about himself!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon wants to give him an ugly nickname... but if you tick off an adeptus, the only thing you'll probably ever find in treasure chests is cabbages! Bleurgh!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh... Guess we should go ask the boss lady of the inn about just how she manages to talk to adepti.

talks.objective: Ask the boss lady about Xiao

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about that adeptus

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: Oh? You've already met Xiao?

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: Not bad. Not often he's in a good enough mood to agree to see people.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's his good mood?

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: Oh yes, the adepti are very hard to come by. Many people go their whole lives praying to them, never once actually getting to see one.

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: When the Geo Archon built Liyue, he borrowed power from the adepti.

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: But most of them only know how to protect Liyue by fighting.

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: So for many millennia, it has instead been humans who have led Liyue, whilst the adepti have lived hidden away on the outskirts.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You really know a lot, huh boss lady.

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: It's not "boss lady," it's just boss...

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: Anyway, seen as you have the favor of the adepti, things should be a lot easier.

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: Well... If you wanna know my opinion... If you keep Xiao in a good mood, things should be okay.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Good mood? Can't really imagine what a "good mood" looks like for that "Vigilant Yaksha."

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: Haha! Will be interesting, won't it?

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: (Come to think of it, I've never seen him smile either...)

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: How 'bout this — you go see the chef for a bowl of Almond Tofu, and a plate of whatever it is you are best at making.

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: Almond Tofu is one of the few human foods Xiao likes. The other dish is up to you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Up to us, eh...? {NICKNAME}, what do you think you're the best at cooking?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Really hard to screw that one up, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But, if we're gonna be cooking for an adeptus, perhaps the Satisfying Salad would be the safer choice...

choices.text: Perhaps a Maha Manjusaka Hot Pyro Slime?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow! Never heard of that one! Paimon wants to try it!

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Can't you see I'm on a break kid? Scram.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Excuse me, we'd like an Almond To—

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Scram!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, this chef guy's service is about as good as that Wagner guy's back in Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's for the boss, Goldet.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: I see. If it's for the boss, then guess I don't have a choice now, do I?

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: But my heart's not really in it right now, not enough to make a dessert as painstaking as Almond Tofu.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And why is that?

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: A fencer's hand must be steady, so too must the hand of a chef.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: But my hands, I'm... they're not steady...

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Because ahh, a traveler once told me that this inn... is haunted.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: And then, just now — just now! In the kitchen... I saw something... something not right.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: (This chef looks so intimidating, but speak of ghosts and he becomes weak.)

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: I keep thinking... even Wangshu Inn isn't safe. I—I can't keep a steady hand for something like Almond Tofu.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Alright {NICKNAME}. In the name of high-quality Almond Tofu, we need to go check this kitchen out.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Doesn't seem to be anyth—

talks.objective: Tell Smiley Yanxiao about what happened

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: What!? You saw it too! There really is a ghost!

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: What... How can I...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay, so he's useless now. What do we do?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Forget it. Let's just go see the boss lady again.

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: Hehe... Scared of something so insignificant. Hard to believe he was once a notorious bandit.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You don't seem that afraid of ghosts, boss lady.

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: Gods and ghosts, I've seen it all before.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Come to think of it, others don't seem to know there's an adeptus here at the inn, except for the boss lady...

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: Shh!

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: Say any more and you'll be divulging my little secret.

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: Right. Best you two be off. Go see to it that little ghost doesn't go scaring anybody else.

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: Not that I'm ordering you around. It's like the adeptus said, mortal souls are not as robust as those of the adepti.

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: So as to not be harmed when dealing with the adepti, you can start by practicing with that ghost.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But how should we persuade the ghost?

response.speaker: Verr Goldet
response.text: There is a calligraphy painting in the inn known as the Witness Sigil. It's been in circulation for over a thousand years. Go take a look at it.

response.speaker: Verr Goldet
response.text: Once you have, look for a place outside where you can see the exact same Witness Sigil formation.

choices.text: But how should we persuade the ghost?

talks.objective: Find a place where you can see the whole Witness Sigil

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Great! Boss lady said she won't be able to get away like last time!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Th—There she is! So scary... {NICKNAME}, quick, you... you grab her.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Argh! She doesn't know when to give up!

dialogues.speaker: Dusky Ming
dialogues.text: ♪ Silly-churl, billy-churl ♪...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Phew... Finally caught you. Paimon's pooped.

dialogues.speaker: Dusky Ming
dialogues.text: ♪ Silly-billy hilichurl ♪ ...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Haunting things isn't nice! Little girl, are you listening?

dialogues.speaker: Dusky Ming
dialogues.text: ♪ Chilly-churl, frilly-churl ♪ ...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Now listen here young lady!

dialogues.speaker: Dusky Ming
dialogues.text: Okay.

dialogues.speaker: Dusky Ming
dialogues.text: Dusky Ming won't tease the travelers at the inn anymore.

dialogues.speaker: Dusky Ming
dialogues.text: #Next time {NICKNAME} can come play with Dusky Ming.

dialogues.speaker: Dusky Ming
dialogues.text: If you don't come and play, Dusky Ming will come find you~

talks.objective: Tell Smiley Yanxiao about what happened

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Wh-What... You really got the ghost to promise to stop haunting the inn?

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Wow... You really are something...

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: I am in your debt.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Please wait a moment. I'll make you the smoothest, silkiest bowl of Almond Tofu.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Haha, my hands are steadier than ever now that she's gone.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: ...You two again.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait! Don't go disappearing again.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: What's this?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's your favorite, Almond Tofu! As well as this distant traveler's best dish — a Satisfying Salad.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}! Quick! Tell him everything before he finishes eating!

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Rex Lapis... How could this be?

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: I... can't imagine it. Though times have changed, I've never imagined a Liyue without him.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: The ruling Qixing... Just what role have they played in this?

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: I will seek Moon Carver, Mountain Shaper, and Cloud Retainer. It is time they too made their decisions.

choices.text: Will the adepti take over his role in Liyue?

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: Adepti do not turn on their responsibilities.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: I have my reasons to not want to be tainted by the mortal realm, but... responsibilities are responsibilities.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: Our god is the God of Contracts after all.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait! Paimon still has one last question.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: Hmm?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That... Dusky Ming. She's...

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: When conquering demons, on occasion, you can come across spirits who have never hurt anyone, yet are also not yet able to be moved on.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: So I asked the innkeeper and the boss if they could keep her here for a time.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So really, Wangshu Inn was looking after her! Really keeping a wide range of business going, huh!

choices.text: Will the adepti interrogate the Qixing?

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: A Sigil of Permission? You came prepared.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Though this only prevents me from hurting you myself. Doesn't stop you from getting hurt in other ways.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uhh... Paimon doesn't get it...

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Too much contact with our world is breaking the rules.

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: Ghosts are just another form of life on earth. It's certainly possible to deal with them on their own terms.

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: Opportunities to meet an adeptus are rare and fleeting. Make the most of it.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: I haven't enjoyed something so much in a long time. That dish was pure perfection.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: May the G—Geo Lord protect you... May all the deities protect you!

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: If the bosses hadn't been so good to me, there's no way I'd be putting up with this...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: Safe travels.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about your husband.

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: Over there. He's the innkeeper.

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: Don't be led astray by the cheeky grin on his face. He is a rather formidable martial artist.

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: I also practice martial arts, as do the kitchen staff. It is a hiring requirement.

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: You have to have nimble use of your hands and feet when you're serving guests, don't you think?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Who are you?

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: My name is Goldet and I come from Mondstadt. I am the boss here at the Wangshu Inn.

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: Lest you think I was the boss' wife.

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: I'm the boss, with a capital "B-O-S-S."

response.speaker: Verr Goldet
response.text: Hahaha, well I'd hardly be able to operate an inn in this location without connections with the Qixing.

response.speaker: Verr Goldet
response.text: What I mean is I obviously need their approval.

response.speaker: Verr Goldet
response.text: All that other nonsense is just rumors, though.

response.speaker: Verr Goldet
response.text: Speaking of which, have you got any interesting news to share?

response.speaker: Verr Goldet
response.text: *sigh* ...This cat invited itself here... But it's cute, so I let it stay.

response.speaker: Verr Goldet
response.text: Its name is Wei. That was quite simply the first name we thought of.

response.speaker: Verr Goldet
response.text: You might find Wei causes a bit of mischief — you know what cats are like. But please refrain from stooping to the same level yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: Hello! ...A distinctive but elusive dress sense, defined yet atypical facial features, and followed around everywhere by a floating elf companion. Hmm... nope. Can't place you.
